statements.t: The increase in gross profit margin was primarily driven by an increase in shipments to our U.S. customers that typically generated higher margins, overall improvements in efficiency brought about by our continuous automation projects, and better control over raw material purchases.

Based on our current operating plan, we believe that cash on hand and cash generated from operating activities will be sufficient to support our working capital needs for the next 12 months from the date this Quarterly Report is released.
We expect that our capital expenditures will increase in the following two fiscal years to create additional capacity to underpin our long-term business plan.
Renovations at our most recently acquired facility, along with the construction of a third satellite factory supported by the Jordanian government, are expected to be completed by September 2027.

Together, these projects are anticipated to increase our production capacity by approximately 15-20 percent, positioning us to meet growing customer demand and support Jerash’s long-term growth objectives,” Choi added.
